newsitem.title: ESTONIA: FARMA AUDITED PROFIT SLIGHTLY LOWER.
newsitem.headline: FARMA AUDITED PROFIT SLIGHTLY LOWER.

text.p: Tallinna Farmaatsiatehas audited net profit in 1996 was 27 million kroons, slightly lower than the 29.58 million kroons unaudited profit, the company said on Thursday.
The company said it therefore did not meet its profit estimate of 29.3 million kroons.
It said in a statement it had to take into account potential income tax duty of 438,847 kroons and the formation of a reserve against bad and doubtful debts of 1.999 million kroons.
The net profit per share was 7.17 kroons in 1996.
The company's net profit rose by 65.1 percent in 1996 compared to the profit of 16.39 million kroons in 1995.
Total assets were 123.7 million kroons in 1996 compared to 72.7 million kroons in 1995.
